{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to numeric, handling commas
# The data shows that some values have commas (e.g., '999,999.99')
# So we need to remove commas and cast to float
df['revenue_numeric'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Now check for QA orders (999999.99) — they are not real
qa_mask = df['revenue_numeric'] == 999999.99
print(f"Number of QA orders: {qa_mask.sum()}")

# Drop QA orders
df_clean = df[~qa_mask].copy()

# Confirm the clean dataset has 900 - 6 = 894 rows
print(f"Clean dataset shape: {df_clean.shape}")"}
